caseName: Board of Commissioners v. Ohio ex rel. Bowman
caseNameFull: Board of Commissioners of Allen County, Ohio v. Ohio ex rel. Bowman
attorneys: Mr. H. E. Garling, with whom Messrs. Ernest M. Botkin, Melvin C. Light, and J. J. Weadick, Sr., were on the brief, for appellants., Messrs. U. G. Denman and William H. Harris were on the brief for appellee., Messrs. Gilbert Bettman, Attorney General of Ohio, and Wm. S. Evatt, by leave of Court, filed a brief on behalf of the State of Ohio, as amicus curiae.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The appeal herein is dismissed for the want of a substantial federal question. (1) County of Mobile v. Kimball, 102 U. S. 691, 703, 704; Houck v. Little River Drainage District, 239 U. S. 254, 262; Joslin Mfg. Co. v. City of Providence, 262 U. S. 668, 674; Memphis & Charleston Ry. Co. v. Pace, 282 U. S. 241, 245, 246; (2) Doyle v. Atwell, 261 U. S. 590, 591, 592; McCoy v. Shaw, 277 U. S. 302, 303; Howat v. Kansas, 258 U. S. 181, 185, 186.
